messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads-up — AcmeCloud listing wants a single evidence bundle by next Wed for SOC2 summary, the last pen-test report, and the completed vendor questionnaire. We need owners and a safe upload plan.

sam-security: Assigning myself for the SOC2 and questionnaire review. Can someone confirm where the pen-test PDF currently lives?

oliver-si: I have the pen-test but it's a redacted copy. Original is in secure GCS under gs://redwood-evidence/acmecloud/pen/2025-03. Need presigned links for partner upload?

maria-partnerships: Yes presigned S3/GCS links preferred. Partner asked for a single zip with manifest + checksums. They also want contact for witness session if they need to validate firmware signing.

sam-security: We should not include any PII or internal secrets. Renee, do we need a legal attestation before presign?

renee-legal: Quick answer: yes. We need a short attestation email chain and a signed NDA for any raw test artifacts. For the redacted bundle we can use a PS-accepted attestation. Who will own the attestation?

oliver-si: I can own the witness scheduling and the S3 presign orchestration. For attestation, happy to collect signatures but will need the template.

sam-security: I'll produce a redaction checklist and run a quick scan for secrets. Plan: generate redacted pen PDF + SOC2 summary extract (control-level only) + completed vendor questionnaire (.xlsx). Then we make a zip and upload to a private bucket with 7-day presign TTL.

maria-partnerships: 7-day TTL sounds fine. Partner wants a downloadable link in their portal by Monday morning. We should aim to have the bundle uploaded by EOD Sunday.

renee-legal: I'll drop the attestation template here. Please fill in: owner name, artifact list, redaction statement, NDA reference.

renee-legal: ```
Attestation template v1.0
- Owner: <name>
- Artifacts: <list>
- Redaction statement: No customer or employee PII included. Internal IP sections redacted under section X.Y.
- NDA ref: <contract id>
- Date:
Signature: <name>
```

oliver-si: Copying process: create folder acmecloud_marketplace_2025-03, put artifacts, generate manifest.json with sha256 checksums, zip as acmecloud_evidence_202503.zip. Command I usually use:

oliver-si: ```bash
# generate manifest
find . -type f -name '*.pdf' -o -name '*.xlsx' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 > manifest.sha256
zip -r acmecloud_evidence_202503.zip manifest.sha256 *.pdf *.xlsx
```

maria-partnerships: Great — when you create the bucket, tag it with partner:acmecloud + marketplace:acme so we can index. Also note copy to long-term archive bucket after 90 days per retention policy.

sam-security: Redaction checklist quick notes: remove IP addresses from logs, mask user IDs, strip full stack traces with user data, remove screenshots with emails. I will run trufflehog and secret-scan before zipping.

oliver-si: I'll provision a presign endpoint. We use presign TTL=604800 (7 days) and max-downloads=10. Should the manifest include filenames + checksums + redaction version?

renee-legal: Yes include redaction version and who performed redaction. Also add a line: legal_review: <renee-legal> date.

maria-partnerships: Partner asked if we can provide a minimal SOC2 control mapping doc (mapping our control names to their required entries). Sam can you do a 1-pager?

sam-security: Yep — I'll create control-mapping-acmecloud.pdf with bullet points. Will include only control IDs and high-level descriptions, no internal evidence pointers.

deploy-bot: [system] Reminder: marketplace-upload-role has been provisioned for oliver-si with expiration 2025-04-07T23:59:00Z.

oliver-si: Upload plan and owners:
- oliver-si: presign + upload orchestration + manifest
- sam-security: redaction + control mapping + final QA
- renee-legal: attestation sign-off
- maria-partnerships: partner comms + portal link

maria-partnerships: Can we do a quick sync Fri 10am PT to run through checklist and confirm bundle produced? If yes I'll invite partner PM too.

sam-security: 10am PT works. I'll post the redaction checklist and initial report by Friday 6pm PT so initial review can happen.

renee-legal: I'll pre-fill attestation and review after Sam's checklist.

oliver-si: I'll create staging folder and start copying redacted artifacts as they become available. Will ping when presign links are ready.

maria-partnerships: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with invite + partner contact. :thumbsup:
